title: Add release team
author: ipa-danb
body:
* Name of the new release team: frame_editor
* Release repositories to add:
  <!--
  Before release repositories are created, repositories and packages should be submitted to the official rosdistro repository https://github.com/ros/rosdistro for naming review.
  The ros/rosdistro source entry link must be included for each repository.
  Guidelines for package naming are describe in REP-144: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-0144.html

  If there are any existing release repositories which should have their contents imported into the ros2-gbp organization, list and link to them here.
  Leave the checkbox _unchecked_. The ros2-gbp administrator will check the box when they have completed the repository import.
  -->
  * [rqt_frame_editor_plugin](  https://github.com/ipa320/rqt_frame_editor_plugin)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/46393)
    * [ ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: [release_repo](https://github.com/ipa320/rqt_frame_editor_plugin-release)


* Team members
  * [@ipa-danb](https://github.com/ipa320/rqt_frame_editor_plugin/blob/dev/ros2/package.xml#L7)

comments.author: ipa-danb
comments.body: Hi, im trying to release a former ROS1 package for ROS2. Im not sure if im doing everything correctly, i.e., not sure if i need to put a PR to the rosdistro if there already exists an entry for `noetic`?

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: Hi @ipa-danb, I think it's worth sending a rosdistro index PR for rolling or another ROS 2 distro. In general most packages that were part of ROS 1 distributions are likely to pass our review checks for ROS 2 but better to undergo those checks explicitly than accidentally let something slide.

comments.author: ipa-danb
